Here are some key facts about Francis Ngannou:

- Francis Ngannou is a professional mixed martial artist who competes in the heavyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC).

- He was born on September 5, 1986 in Batié, Cameroon and grew up in severe poverty. He did not start training in MMA until he was 22 years old.

- Ngannou is known for his immense punching power and is considered one of the hardest hitters in the history of the UFC. He has won several of his fights by devastating knockout.

- Some of Ngannou's notable UFC achievements include winning the UFC Heavyweight Championship in 2022, and holding the record for the most powerful punch ever recorded at 129 pounds of force.

- Prior to MMA, Ngannou worked a variety of jobs like sand miner and homeless street vendor in Paris, France to support himself before deciding to pursue a career in fighting.

- He is renowned for his rags-to-riches story and is considered a role model and inspiration to many, especially in his home country of Cameroon.

- Ngannou is known for his powerful wrestling and grappling skills in addition to his striking abilities. He has won several of his fights by submissions as well as knockouts.

- Outside of fighting, Ngannou is involved in various charitable initiatives focused on helping underprivileged youth in Africa.

In summary, Francis Ngannou is a dominant UFC heavyweight champion known for his incredible punching power and inspirational backstory of overcoming poverty to reach the top of his sport.
